reviews.text: Our Ruby is feeling better thanks to Royal Vet. Thank you for taking care of her like you did.

I couldn’t have asked for a better experience for my puppy’s first vet visit! Everyone was so welcoming and genuinely caring. It is very obvious the entire staff loves what they do. Dr. Karla Gonzalez and her team made sure my puppy was comfortable throughout the entire appointment. She was amazing, thorough, and compassionate. She made sure my puppy was comfortable before starting any exam. It really means so much knowing my puppy is in such good hands! 🐾💕

Very attentive doctors, nurses and staff! My two cats have been going here for a long time. I always feel well cared for when we go.

The spay surgery for my second cat also went well and she healed quickly with no issues.

Great staff and very clean facilities along with Dr.Riera which is vey knowledgeable.
She has been treating our German Shepard for eight years and we are very pleased !

I want to thank Dr. Maristany and all the doctors, nurses, assistants, and office staff at the clinic. Thank you all for your care and concern during my pet's surgery. Thanks to everyone, my pet came through the operation very well. It's a very good veterinary clinic, 100% recommended.
Excellent care for my dog, great customer service, great prizes, very clean ! Dr Gonzalez is terrific!
Excellent service from the front desk to the Vet.  You can tell that everyone at Royal Vet really loves animals.
Definitely 5 stars! The entire staff was friendly and loving with our dogs and made them feel safe and cared for. Highly recommend!!

Needed a sane day appointment for my cat and the staff was extremely friendly and accommodating. Had an appointment in less than 2 hours. Once there I was promptly received and everyone was super kind and caring to my cat. Would definitely recommend.
I took my Bubba to get checked out and the service, the staff and the Doctor were amazing!  Highly recommend

Hands down the best vet! Friendly staff and doctor. Friscos first visit went well and they allowed the whole exam and blood draw to be with us so that my boy would have a good experience. This truly builds the foundation of a less anxiety dog when visiting the vet in the future. Lots of treats and kind words! Glad to have this place as Friscos primary vet.
Everyone at Royal Vet took excellent care of my two cats. I highly recommend them.

You will not find more experienced and compassionate doctors then Dr Riera and Dr Maristoni!
They have taken care of numerous pets throughout the years and I wouldn't take my babies anywhere else.

Thank you for always being there for us and giving us the best care.

Plus the office is very clean in the office staff sweet and very helpful!
Top recommendation from me!
Best vet / animal hospital I’ve ever been to. Organized, friendly, excellent customer service. 10/10 would recommend!
Caring, detailed, thorough and most importantly very humane service. Loved the experience. Thanks

Our experience here has been nothing short of amazing! The front desk, techs, support staff and the doctors have taken extra special care of Jordan. As the primary handler for the first hospital facility dog for a local hospital I can happily say I have found a vet(s) for life. Dr. Maristany, Dr. Riera and Dr. Gonzalez are the best team of doctors I have ever worked with. 🥰🐶❤️

Dr. Maristany, Diana, and the entire staff were absolutely amazing! They truly care about their patients and go above and beyond to make sure every pet receives the best care possible. You can tell they genuinely love animals and know exactly how to treat them. Highly recommend! 🙏🏻💕 …
The staff was wonderful and quick.   They kept me abreast of the progress from the very first moment, and they were quite comforting and reassuring.
Excellent veterinary practice.

I had to book a last-minute appointment for my dog because he wasn't feeling well, and I was so grateful that they were able to fit us in. The entire staff and veterinarian were incredibly kind, compassionate, and knowledgeable. They took the time to answer all of my questions and made both my dog and me feel well cared for. I truly appreciate the excellent care and would highly recommend them.
Excellent clinic, the service was superb, a 10 out of 10, I highly recommend it 💯
Best Vet in Miami ⭐️
Dr. Maristany is the best vet. She is so attentive and caring to my dog and her needs.

Took my big baby to the vet today, they were kind and helpful AT THE END OF THEIR SHIFT, which I think is valuable. They’re bilingual and care for your animal as if it was their own. Only negative is their prices are pretty high but considering they have the best ratings in town, you get what you pay for. Very clean place, the decor is very stylish and up to date. They seem to really care for the animals and provide top quality care. Thank you very much!! They will be my primary vet for all my animals. Very thankful. (My boy has a double ear infection and hematoma and they treated him so well) they preformed a surgery on him a couple days afterwards, successful so far no new fluid build up which is a  success for our senior boy!

Undoubtedly the best place for you to take your pet! Attentive since the appointment, when we arrived, there was her name on the door of the office. The impeccable veterinary consultation, and the acupuncture and laser session was great for my dog. I am delighted with the care and follow-up.
Thanks to all the team for the fast appointment and great service.
Great staff and doctors. Very welcoming.
Always very professional and treat pets great. They listen to your concerns and address they well.
Great place amazing staff 👏 🙌🏻 👍🏻 …

Love Royal Pet Vet in Pinecrest! Highly recommend them! They are super attentive,  from the staff to the Drs. Caring & knowledgeable❤️ not to mention it’s very clean & prompt! My Spotty hit the jackpot!!!

Got an ER appointment same day (on a Sunday) when I called to say my dog had vomited.  Was seen right away.  Dr. Riera and her techs were super professional, nice and so gentle with my anxious pet.  I would highly recommend Royal Vet Animal Hospital
Very clean, friendly,  caring & proffesional staff
Excellent across the board

This is truly the best clinic. Our dog, Toto, recently passed away, and we brought him here for a private cremation even though we had not been patients before. From the moment we arrived, the staff was incredibly compassionate, respectful, and welcoming during such a difficult time.

They followed up with multiple thoughtful messages, including a hand-signed letter expressing their condolences. Their kindness meant so much to us, and we are very grateful for the care and compassion they showed our family.

Very welcoming and clean and got a same day appointment! Staff was very thorough and patient and answered all of our questions kindly and in great detail. Would definitely recommend to any pet owners!

There are no words to fully express my gratitude to the Royal Vet Family and Dr. Maristany for the love, compassion, and exceptional care they gave my beloved Romeo and Sophie throughout their lives.

As a pet parent, saying goodbye is one of the hardest things we ever have to do. When Romeo and Sophie crossed over the rainbow bridge, the kindness,  empathy, and support shown by Dr. Maristany and the entire team meant more to me than I can ever put into words.

They never treated Romeo and Sophie as just patients, they treated them as cherished members of the family. Every visit was met with warmth, patience, and genuine concern, and I always knew they were in the best hands possible.

Thank you for helping care for my sweet Romeo and Sophie and for being there during some of our most difficult moments. Your compassion was truly remarkable, and I will always be grateful for the love you showed them and our family.

Forever grateful,
Millie Basto
The vet and the receptionist were super nice to me and amazing with my pet I would highly recommend!

Genuinely incredible staff Front Desk girl The Vet and Vet tech that I had were extremely kind. However Dee the vet manager I’m assuming gave me a call because I was a bit taken back about pricing that was never brought to my attention regarding processing a stool sample and a follow up visit. During this conversation, Dee was rude and dismissive And told me “you may have expectations, but that’s not how we work” Mind you, my expectation was just being told that I had to pay for something. The vet told me that I had to bring a stool sample when I get there. I am about to leave and then they stopped me and go. You have to pay $133 Which was never brought to my attention once. And then when I’m telling Dee About how if their Vet offers a follow up visit because the kitten is too small to do anything during the initial visit maybe let them know you’re gonna have a charge. Instead, she says all visits have charges. We’re not gonna let you know that we’re gonna charge you something. We’ll let you know after the appointment. Then she proceeded to contradict herself saying that all follow up appointments are different and then right after she said that they all have a base price. So then you would think that you would mention that base price to a customer. Like I said this stuff there is extremely kind. They’re funny. They’re super nice however Dee needs to take some lessons on customer service. Prior to this, I would have recommended the Vet just because of how nice everybody was, but I would quite literally not let anybody go there if it were up to me just because of how awful That office manager is
Every One was friendly, caring and accommodating.   My older cat was not feeling well and my appointment was for 6:30 pm, I  called back and I was able to go in at 2:30 pm.  Very great full.
Wouldn’t trust any other clinic with my precious Sam!!
Very professional and caring
Great service. Highly recommended.

Very happy with this clinic.  We were worked into the schedule with no waiting time!  The young ladies at the front desk were kind.  Diana, the assistant was super friendly and very informative when explaining things 😊!  Dr. Riera was fantastic, very good at her job!  You can tell she is passionate about her patients well being!  I really can’t say enough good things about them!
Very very very spencer

It was 20 minutes before closing, and I had never been there before and they said I could come in and they would take care of my kitty. I felt that the price was fairly reasonable and they really did care for my pet.
Royal vet is the best clinic I’ve ever taken a pet.  They are conscious about how you spend your money and they only do what is needed
I highly recommend Royal Vet. Dr. Gonzalez is amazing!

Highly recommend this veterinary office! The entire staff is kind, friendly, professional, and truly caring. Dr. Gonzalez recently neutered my 2 1/2 year old dog and did an excellent job. They also take wonderful care of my 10-week-old puppy.

The office is always fast and efficient while still providing high-quality care and attention to every pet. You can genuinely tell that the doctors and staff love what they do, and it shows in how they treat both the animals and their owners. I’m so grateful to have found such an amazing vet team!
Love Dr.Gonzalez and the whole team!! Great personalized care… recommend to all!
Dr. Maristany and staff are simply the best!

Brought my dog in today for an eye infection and could not have had a better experience. Dr. Riera was knowledgeable, thorough, and genuinely warm. Exactly the kind of vet you hope to find. The staff was equally wonderful, making the whole visit feel easy and welcoming. He is usually anxious at the vet, but he was calm and comfortable the entire time. That says a lot about the environment they’ve created here. We came in as first-timers and left as regulars. Highly recommend RoyalVet to anyone looking for quality care with a personal touch.

Today was my first visit to confirm Mia’s pregnancy, and I truly loved the experience. Seeing the puppies through the ultrasound was such an emotional and beautiful moment, and it honestly felt like we were experiencing it as a family.

Emily and Dr. Riera were incredibly kind and patient, and they explained all the care recommendations for Mia during and after her pregnancy. Every question we had was answered, and we left feeling reassured and well taken care of.

We absolutely fell in love with the attention we received and how warm and welcoming the clinic feels.

Royal Vet is an amazing place the best of the best care and Vets!! You are treated like family. If anyone that has a dog or a cat do not miss the opportunity to visit Royal Vet hospital  you cannot and will not go wrong

Love my visits to RoyalVet! It truly is the royal experience every time I go there with my Yorkie Prince. We are warmly welcomed every single time and always feel comfortable and at home upon arrival. Dr. Gonzalez, Dr. Riera, and Dr. Maristany have years of experience in the field and have been my dogs vets for years and fully trust them with my eyes closed. Highly recommend this establishment and these vets to everyone!
The veterinarian and the team were exceptional. They took good care of my cat. I am very satisfied. I like that they have evening and Saturdays appointments. I highly recommend them.
best place for your pet i cannot recommend a place more highly
Whenever I have to bring my dog in, I always feel confident he is in very capable and caring hands. Great service and care. Would recommend again and again!

As always, Royal Vet lives up to their name. We get the Royal treatment every time we go with all our pets. The friendly staff makes you feel welcomed and like at home. We highly recommend this center and its doctors and staff. Raul V.
Very nice employees  and they took great care of Bentley!!
Dr Riera has been my veterinarian for years. Has taken care of my kitty Kats, fosters, kitten. She is the best. Very knowledgeable and gentle.
Great staff. Highly recommend
Dr. Maristany and her team provided amazing, compassionate care for my pet. Their kindness, expertise, and attention to detail made the experience exceptional, and I highly recommend them.
The doctors are amazing as is the staff.  Very caring and smart group!!!

My dog Sweetie and I love Dr. Maristany and the fantastic crew at Royal Vet Pinecrest. 16.5 year old Sweetie is treated like royalty, as it should be! Always greeted with warmth, we appreciate the care we receive. Thank you all for your kindness.
Great team…friendly yet professional…great environment!
What a breathe of fresh air! Royal Vet was timely, professional and incredibly caring to beloved pup! Wish we would have found them sooner.

Everyone that works at Royal Vet Pinecrest is amazing! They helped my cat Blue survive FIP and recently, Dr. Gonzalez and Milli, took exceptional care of Blue when he went in yesterday with a broken paw. We love you all so much, thank you, thank you, thank you for all the loving kindness and patience you always give to me and my pets!!! Xoxoxo
Wonderful service.

I took my baby Mia in because her ear was bothering her and they took such great care of her. Millie especially was so sweet and took Mia to the back to meet everyone, which was adorable. Dr. Gonzalez was also great and very patient with my fidgety girl. We’re very happy with the care she received and am glad we found a great new vet.
